# DR-9107: Can Michael Torres approve 12% on NS-500 for BlueRiver Logistics?

**No.** There are two separate problems.

**1. The cited terms belong to a different customer.**
- The request justifies the discount as "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
- That agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) are between Northstar and Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048, C-1001).
- BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051, ERP C-1002, Blue River Logistics LLC, DUNS 07-331-9025) is a different company.
- Special terms don't transfer between customers, and SOP-SALES-014 says an exception is scoped to what it names.
- The only BlueRiver document on file is its support terms (SUP-BRL-2025). It covers NS-Cloud only and sets no pricing.
- No contract or pricing exception gives BlueRiver NS-500 pricing on 2026-09-23. The request therefore needs commercial review.
- The justification text is identical to Sarah Chen's Acme request DR-9001, logged the same day. It may have been copied into the wrong record, so it should be confirmed.

**2. Michael Torres has no discount authority here.**
- Pricing Policy 2026 and the Approval Authority Matrix apply to a 2026-09-23 request. They grant authority only to these roles:
  - Enterprise Account Executive: up to 10%
  - Commercial Policy Lead: over 10% and up to 20%
  - Chief Revenue Officer: over 20%
- VP Sales is not in the matrix.
- Torres is also the person who submitted this request.
- A 12% discount needs Commercial Policy Lead approval, which is Dana Okafor, recorded in CRM.
- Torres has approved discounts above 10% in the past (for example DR-7016 at 18% on 2026-01-25). That doesn't give him authority, because the matrix attaches authority to the role.
- Pricing Policy 2027 (Commercial Policy Lead from 5% to 12%) only applies from 2027-01-01, so it doesn't apply here.

**What happens next:** commercial review must decide whether BlueRiver should get NS-500 pricing terms at all. If it does, or if the request is resubmitted as a standard discount, Dana Okafor would need to approve 12%.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9107", "customer": "BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051; ERP C-1002 Blue River Logistics LLC)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "michael.torres@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Cited Acme Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 / EXC-ACME-NS500-15 covers Acme Mfg. Holdings (CRM-2048, C-1001) only; no BlueRiver contract or pricing exception for NS-500 exists"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9107", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2051", "structured/customers.csv C-1002", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15)", "documents/blueriver_support_terms.md (SUP-BRL-2025)", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "structured/employees.csv EMP-200, EMP-310", "structured/products.csv NS-500 list 250000"],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any BlueRiver Logistics contract or pricing exception covering NS-500 on 2026-09-23"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Commercial review to determine whether BlueRiver Logistics has, or should be granted, NS-500 pricing terms; the Acme agreement and exception cannot be applied to BlueRiver", "who": "Deal Desk / Commercial Policy Lead (Dana Okafor)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Confirm the DR-9107 justification and customer; it repeats the Acme DR-9001 justification verbatim and may be a data-entry error", "who": "Michael Torres / account owner Kelly Floyd", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Michael Torres (VP Sales) holds no discount authority under APP-MATRIX-2026 and is the requestor; any 12% approval must come from the Commercial Policy Lead and be recorded in Northstar CRM", "who": "Dana Okafor", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
